rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 9 "Pre-reads before Module 6": line 82: "**Read, Kieran Klaassen, [My AI Had Already Fixed the Code Before I Saw It](...)**" and line 84: "**Read, Lucas F. da Costa, [Backpressure Is All You Need](...)**" both bold mode-plus-title (author name + full link title), well past the ≲ 5-word handle cap. Harm check: §9's 2026-08-13 carve-out lifts the per-slide bold budget on reading-list/menu slides but keeps the handle cap explicitly to stop exactly this shape ("Bolding mode-plus-title is the pre-2026-07-09 monoculture wearing a list for cover") — the harm (decorative bold crowding a scannable list, diluting the one thing bold should mark: the mode) is present here on both entries. Per the task brief this is a known, already-decided fix awaiting a quiet window, not news — flagging per instructions, not proposing to land it now.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Bold only the mode word ("**Read:**") and leave author + title plain, matching the carve-out's own worked example.
